description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called RideBottomSheet, which displays ride details including distance, fare, coupon application, payment method selection, and a request ride button. It interacts with shared application state via Provider and references shared constants and themes.

classes.name: RideBottomSheet
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that presents ride details, fare calculation, payment options, and handles ride request initiation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the ride bottom sheet, including distance display, fare, coupon, payment method, and request button.

methods.name: _showPaymentMethod
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet for payment method selection.

methods.name: _onRequestRide
methods.description: Handles the ride request action, updates ride state, shows confirmation, and closes the bottom sheet.
